title: SimplifiedRules
description: Gives new players a configurable rules book on first join. Easily set title, author, and contents via config.
body:
**SUPPORT ME: ko-fi.com/slrrxx**

 This Paper plugin automatically gives new players a customizable rules book on their first join. Server admins can easily configure the book’s title, author, and contents through a simple config file, ensuring every player sees your server rules exactly as intended.
